question: Why is this tetrad called the inner group in the phonemic emanation?
premises: A fourfold group has just been described.
It is contained within will and the other powers.
It abides at the point of their own completion.
inference: The tetrad is called inner because it remains internal to the powers and marks their culmination.
uncertainties: The exact members of the tetrad are carried over from the immediately preceding verses.
plain_english: This fourfold group is called the inner one because it is contained within will and the other powers and abides at their completion.
